registration.note: Design proposal only. No designed dispatches or run records exist. DoE oversight must review/admit and lock campaign-specific decision thresholds before cohort creation or execution.

hypothesis.statement: For bounded game-development tasks, a specialist instance with context-matched engine/tool profiles and build-linked runtime verification will improve verified requirement satisfaction and reduce regression/rework versus a generic build-only baseline.
hypothesis.null: Context/tool specialization and runtime verification do not improve verified outcomes after task family, engine and difficulty are blocked.
hypothesis.limits: This is a proposed hypothesis, not an observed result.

design.type: Taguchi L9 screening design (DoE-supported generator; proposed)
design.assignment: Randomized treatment assignment within predeclared task-family blocks. Record exclusions, deviations and unexecuted assignments; do not relabel observational work as designed.
design.unit_of_observation: One executed task under one fully stamped configured specialist instance = one EXPERIMENT record.
eligibility: Project-owned, open-source or explicitly authorized game-development tasks with stable build identity and acceptance criteria.
A task can be executed safely with the registered tool profiles and available runner.
Tasks requiring urgent incident response, unapproved targets, unavailable licenses or human-only decisions are excluded with a recorded reason.
held_fixed: Same task specification, target SHA/build, acceptance contract and independent review standard across compared arms.
Game-player and QA score events remain separate from development-specialist outcomes.
No provider/model is preselected; candidate selection follows current capability, health, quota and policy admission.
No candidate inherits score, authorization, reviewer status or credentials from a parent.
design.execution_gate: DoE reviewer approves the design, task suite, factor levels, sample plan, selection margin, confidence method and stopping rule before the first designed dispatch.

outcomes.primary: Verified requirement satisfaction rate: accepted requirement IDs / applicable requirement IDs, with all critical requirements passing.
secondary: independently reproduced defect count and severity
outcomes.failure_attribution: Separate agent/model failure, tool/environment failure, task-specification failure, integration failure and verifier failure. Infrastructure failure is not scored as specialist incompetence.

decision_rule.selection_fraction: NOT_ESTABLISHED — DoE must set before execution.
decision_rule.minimum_sample: NOT_ESTABLISHED — DoE must set before execution.
decision_rule.significance_and_confidence: Use the applicable standing DoE gate and record any campaign-specific threshold before the first run.
decision_rule.promotion: Promote only after the pre-registered primary outcome passes, critical requirements pass, independent review is complete and no disqualifying regression is found.
decision_rule.no_selection: If evidence is insufficient, contradictory, underpowered or fails the gate, retain the baseline and continue observation; do not force a winner.

generations.generation_zero: Baseline cohort with stable candidate IDs and exact prompt/tool/configuration hashes.
generations.next_generation: New candidate IDs with explicit parent_candidate_refs; only reviewed prompt/tool/workflow slices are cherry-picked into the new version.
generations.culling: Reversible deactivation only; preserve all records and lineage. Protected QA, security and governance functions are not eligible for autonomous culling.
generations.monitoring: Compare generations on common task strata; monitor quality, correctness, integration, regression, resource cost, saturation and drift.
generations.promotion_authority: DoE oversight plus required independent reviewer and Operator policy where permissions or protected roles are implicated.

instance_stamps.required: EXPERIMENT.schema.json treatment.instance with provider, model@version, exact system_prompt ref+sha256, tools ref+sha256, role, moniker, context and instance_key.
instance_stamps.missing_fields: If provider/model/prompt/tools are not established, record null where schema permits and retain NOT_ESTABLISHED; never fabricate an instance_key.
instance_stamps.record_rule: One record per executed observation in records/; no summary or cohort result may replace raw records.

constraints: No dispatch, pool mutation, provider invocation or candidate promotion occurs by committing this design file.
Campaign does not join the active DoE family until design plus run evidence satisfy DOE-FAMILY admission rules.
Experiment rows are append-only and retained.
No unapproved external target, DRM/anti-cheat bypass, cracking, warez, third-party exploitation or real-money wagering.
No secret values, private user data or unlicensed assets in records.
